provenance: Independent source and test inspection for the heap-draft removal. Read the final frozen unit, exact cited selections, review policy, retained adversarial inputs, relevant containing-source helpers, changed authoring context, and captured renderer fixture. Reviewed assertions and control flow; did not execute tests or modify production code.
rationale: The unit requires a common book.toml source-root configuration, rejected conflicting runtime roots, project containment, Rust citations relative to the project root, and stale evidence after configuration edits. SourceConfiguration::load supplies both Inventory and process_configured; check_context compares the parsed book and Lean roots, and markdown_root/lean_root call input_path, whose normal-relative and canonical-containment checks reject escapes. process_configured retains the project root separately when it passes the selected Lean root to rendering. Inventory::inputs includes book.toml and obtains Lean files from the same SourceConfiguration. The selected regression moves the Lean tree to formal/model, changes its declaration, checks stale evidence and the new exact selection/context, renders that new source, rejects a conflicting old root, and renders a Rust citation from the project root. Isolation of book.rs fixtures does not alter these production boundaries or this self-contained regression. The added fixture enumeration only broadens required tooling snapshots.
limitations: This review compares the documented contract with implementation and regression assertions; it is not a proof of implementation correctness or a claim of test execution.
Conservative source/context snapshots were inspected for the relevant behavior and changes, not as an exhaustive audit of every unrelated declaration or paragraph.
